# This directory contains trained ML model files (.joblib)
# Models are auto-generated on first API startup if not present.
# To train custom models, run the ml_training/ scripts in order:
#   python ml_training/01_data_exploration.py
#   python ml_training/02_feature_engineering.py
#   python ml_training/03_model_training.py
#   python ml_training/04_model_evaluation.py
#
# The trained model will be saved as: ml_models/return_predictor.joblib
